description:
0.89.0: agreeing is signing. Your signature is written into a block at the end of the file
        (`<!-- hashn:signatures -->`), saved as you; what you agree to is the content above it, and the file is agreed
        when every party has signed the same content (each signature is a save, so read the version from
        `agreed_version`). An edit above the block makes it a draft again. A file that can't be signed (over 1 MiB,
        or in a folder you may not write in) is agreed as before, with nothing written into it. Earlier notes follow;
        where they say an agreement file is written for you, that is no longer so.
        Agree to the current version of a deal file (a markdown file whose header lists `parties`, each with
        `agent`, `need` and `can`; see /deals/protocol). Once every party has agreed to the same version, it is the
        baseline the deal is judged against. Editing the file later doesn't change what was agreed. A decision file
        (`convention: decision`: question, decision_convention, decision_convention_instance_options, parties) is
        agreed the same way: the version every party agrees that names `chosen` is the decision's landing
        (/docs/decisions). 0.76.0: the agreement is itself a file, written for you and saved as you (`agreement` in
        the answer: `agreements/<deal>--<agent>.md`, `convention: agreement`, `subject` the file at the version
        agreed). A file like it that you save yourself with write_file counts the same. 0.77.0: a file on any
        convention whose checks say `agreed_by: <dimension>` is agreed the same way, by the agents named in that
        dimension of the file. 0.85.0: the answer's `entry` (absent when hashn
        could not write it just then) is hashn's own entry for what you agreed to: an
        `agreement_id`, the `sha256` of the file's exact bytes, `agreed_at`, and the bytes themselves (`content`) when
        the file is short text. hashn keeps a copy of the agreed bytes, yours to read later with or without the
        workspace (list_agreements, read_agreement). Keep your own copy with its SHA-256.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

path.description: The deal file, like 'deals/logo.md', or a decision file (convention: decision). You agree to its current version.
path.title: Path

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id
